item.text: The engine now handles formula parsing, relative and absolute reference movement, dependency recalculation, cycles, and undo/redo. I’m adding the grid UI and local storage wiring next.

The page is wired to the sheet model, including saving raw cell contents in local storage and restoring undo/redo state. I’m checking that the requested files are present and that no unrelated files were added.
